note: TEMPLATE for the owner (not an export). The routines attach to the agent inbox only (register R-AN-61, R-AN-75 item 1, §16.18 A6): sessions clone Mohamedalhaaj/gold-analyst-inbox and push their attempt, call, lesson and playbook files to its claude/analyst-* branches; analyst-merge in gold-analyst reads them from the inbox's activity. After repointing the routines, the owner exports the real configuration with RemoteTrigger get into analyst/ROUTINE_CONFIG.json, minus anything secret, in its own commit. Prompts are the one-line texts below; each points to a section of the frozen analyst/ROUTINE_PROMPT.md. Every session runs under the session guard committed in .claude/ (R-AN-85, §16.18 A7), which allows only the command lines, reads and draft writes of these prompts. Connectors and plugins: none, on every routine and on the probe routine (register R-AN-61, §16.18 A6 second review, SEC-2). claude.ai attaches every account connector when a routine is created, so every create or update is followed by clearing the connectors and a fresh export in its own commit; the export's raw must show mcp_connections [] and enabled_plugins [] (tests/test_routine_config.py). No routine is created from, or runs as threads of, a claude.ai project (register R-AN-61, §16.18 A7 third review, decision 21): a project's cloud threads run no repository hook and apply neither its permission rules nor its env, so the session guard would not act. Routines are created and updated only with RemoteTrigger create and update or at claude.ai/code/routines, never from a project's conversation or by accepting a project's setup recommendations; a routine found in a project is deleted and created again outside it (its trigger_id changes), cleared of connectors and exported. Each exported routine has project: the project's name as claude.ai shows it, or null for none. When writing each export the owner reads it from the RemoteTrigger get response (every field whose name contains project, case ignored, at any depth, is kept in raw with its value), the routine's page at claude.ai/code/routines and, when the account shows Projects at claude.ai/code, the Scheduled tasks tab of each project, and names the sources read in the export's note. Only null is accepted (tests/test_routine_config.py; the judge's A13 routine_project, an immediate stop).

environment.name: gold-analyst

network.note: Register R-AN-61 and §16.18 A9 (decision A9-D11): access level None, no allowed domain, the default package-manager list off. The GitHub proxy (serving only the attached inbox), the Anthropic API and the hosts of a network secret stay reachable at every level. The session steps import only the standard library and analyst/vendor (tests/test_layout.py), so no package install is needed. Disclosed: through the inbox's webhooks GitHub itself can still reach any address for a session (R-AN-75 item 2); no network setting closes that. Since §16.18 A7 the session guard (.claude/hooks/guard.py, R-AN-85) refuses every call that could create one, and the run-log scan (R-AN-86) and the security log (R-AN-60) detect what it could miss.

network_secrets.name: twelvedata
network_secrets.note: Set by the owner in the environment dialog at claude.ai/code (Network secrets, Add secret): secret type Bearer, allowed website api.twelvedata.com only, one custom header named Authorization with prefix apikey and, as value, the client's Twelve Data key pasted from the macOS keychain item twelvedata-api-key by the owner, never by a session. Anthropic's agent proxy adds the header to requests for that host after they leave the VM; the session never sees the key, and its code (analyst/ga/td.py, R-AN-87) sends no key. The export records name, hosts, header, prefix and the dialog's marker (sent, or not_sent when the list marks the secret Not sent), never the value; tests/test_routine_config.py checks them. A secret applies to every session in its environment: this environment serves only these routines, and the exam runs in another environment without the secret (C19). If the account offers only the short form (one host, type Token), A9 cannot be set as written and the canary waits for a dated amendment.

github_app: The Claude GitHub App installation that routine sessions use has repository access 'Only select repositories' holding gold-analyst-inbox, and never gold-analyst, gold-forward-watch or xauusd-quant (R-AN-75 item 1); no /web-setup copy of the owner's gh token is stored.

probe_session.note: The one-off probe session that must give probe_pass before canary_from is set (register §16.18 A6, Canary; R-AN-84; C5-C7). It runs as a routine of its own, analyst-probe, fired by the owner with run-now, in environment gold-analyst, attached to the inbox only, with the routines' network and tools, and with no connector and no plugin (its RemoteTrigger get is exported with the other routines, SEC-2); it may be rerun at any time. The owner copies the pushed probes/<tag>.json byte for byte to gold-analyst analyst/canary/checks/PROBE_<tag>.json. Since §16.18 A7 it is also C20, the test of the session guard (R-AN-74 C20, R-AN-85): its prompt follows the frozen analyst/PROBE_SESSION_PROMPT.md (step 1 is the probe, then two allowed controls, then harmless forbidden steps the guard must refuse). It runs after the guard's files are on inbox main and before 06:00 UTC of canary_from, again before live_from and after any change of .claude/**, analyst/ROUTINE_PROMPT.md or analyst/PROBE_SESSION_PROMPT.md. Changing this prompt is a routine update: clear the connectors, then export in its own commit. The environment gold-analyst holds no environment variable and, since §16.18 A9, one network secret (api.twelvedata.com); step 1 passes only with net.twelvedata 200 and net.dukascopy refused. The owner writes analyst/canary/checks/C20.json from the run log and runs python3 analyst/jobs/scan_runs.py on it. Since the third review of A7 (decision 22) the probe record holds cc_version, the session's Claude Code version (the first line of claude --version); C20.json copies it unchanged from analyst/canary/checks/PROBE_<tag>.json, and C20 passes only with at least 2.1.295, the version onFailure needs (R-AN-85).
